annotations.title: Which cyber regulations apply across India, the US and the EU

description: For an organisation operating across India, the US and the EU, lists the cyber and data-protection regimes that apply, may apply (check) or are pending, with why and a caution for each. All flags default to false and sizes/sectors to none.

cra_manufacturer.description: Manufacturer of products with digital elements sold in the EU.

eu_personal_data.description: Processes personal data of people in the EU.

ftc_safeguards.description: Non-bank financial institution under the FTC Safeguards Rule.

hipaa.description: Covered entity or business associate under HIPAA.

ict_provider_to_eu_finance.description: ICT third-party provider to EU financial entities.

india_financial_regulated.description: Regulated by RBI, SEBI, IRDAI or IFSCA.

india_listed.description: Listed on an Indian stock exchange.

india_personal_data.description: Processes digital personal data of individuals in India.

nydfs.description: Regulated by the New York DFS.

us_personal_data.description: Holds personal data of US residents.

name: find_global_cyber_regulations
